item.title: Brunch & Brass: SHOUT! — Sun Aug 9, 12:00 PM — Union
item.description:
Soak up the sunshine as lively brass ensembles fill the patio with rich, feel-good sounds—perfectly paired with a relaxed midday bite. It’s a laid-back, joyful way to gather, unwind, and let the music carry you through your Sunday. SHOUT! returns to Union Summer as a dynamic Toronto brass ensemble known for its high-energy performances and rapid growth from small student-led “guerilla concerts” into a full 12-piece band. Rooted in New Orleans brass traditions, SHOUT! blends jazz and Western popular music with global rhythmic and harmonic influences, drawing inspiration from musical cultures across Asia, Africa, Eastern Europe, and South America. The result is a vibrant, genre-crossing sound built for both movement and celebration.
Source: Union Station Toronto

item.title: 🌿🚶‍♂️ YORK BELTLINE TRAIL EVENING WALK & PUB NIGHT 🍻🌿 — Thu Aug 13, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! # 🌿🚶‍♂️ YORK BELTLINE TRAIL EVENING WALK & PUB NIGHT 🍻🌿
**A Hidden Urban Trail, Easy Walking & A Relaxing Summer Evening**
Looking for an easy way to get outside after work?
Join us for a summer evening walk along the York Beltline Trail, one of Toronto's hidden green corridors.
Built on the route of the historic Belt Line Railway, this peaceful trail offers a surprising escape from the city, with mature trees, birdsong, and plenty of shade—all just steps from the subway. This is an easy, mostly flat walk with no major hills, making it perfect for anyone who wants to stretch their legs, enjoy some fresh air, and meet new people.
After our walk, we'll head over to **The Bull: A Firkin Pub** for dinner and a chance to relax, chat, and get to know one another. After all, the walk is just the beginning—the conversations afterward are where friendships often start.

item.description:
Address: Book People on Queen Toronto, ON Canada
Ahead of the wider buzz, join us for a first look at Leave Your Mess at Home, the debut novel from Tolani Akinola — already drawing comparisons to some of the sharpest, funniest family dramas in recent memory. Told through the eyes of four adult siblings navigating a fraught homecoming, it's a story about the versions of ourselves we leave behind, the ones we return to face, and what it costs to be truly known by the people who raised us. We're sitting down with Tolani for a conversation about the book, her path to writing it, and what it's meant to bring this story into the world. Come with…

item.title: High Park Yoga — Thu Oct 1, 6:30 PM
item.description:
High Park Yoga **\~Please [SIGN UP here](https://calendly.com/breathinginnature/yoga-in-nature) for free before the class\~** [Click here for a map of the exact location](https://goo.gl/maps/x1YMV41Bmhcf7chb6).
My community classes in High Park are by donation, for all bodies, and no experience is required. What is yoga? We combine breath, movement and awareness, all in the healing nature of High Park.
**What to bring?**
* Yoga mat (optional - the grass is nice to yoga on) * Water * Weather-appropriate clothing/ blanket for relaxation
We yoga rain or shine. There is shelter if we need it.
